summary: T109 attempt 3 was halted by the controller's protected-path gate before any candidate commit was created. The Developer implemented Review 2's required_changes across 10 source/test files (BacktestEvent cursor fields, (timestamp, 0, 0) fallback removal in the orchestrator, T061 engine delayed-fill pipeline restructure, ReplayHistoricalUnavailableError + HISTORICAL_UNAVAILABLE_REASON, additional acceptance test classes) and locally observed the four T109-related test modules passing, but also edited docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and todo/config.yaml before completing the candidate. The controller reverted those protected-path edits with `git restore --staged --worktree` and interrupted the attempt; the worktree is now back at commit 1d9634f with the candidate-2 state (fac669a) as its base. The T109 contract itself is internally coherent and specifies code-only deliverables (src/ + tests/) — no docs/spec/ edit is required to satisfy the contract — and the pre-existing ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2 citation drift is on base commit 0ef2ce0 and is not a T109 deliverable.
evidence: todo/phases/P06-backtesting-and-strategy/T109.md defines the contract: causal MarketCursor binding, atomic manifest/report/simulation-evidence publication, manifest cutover from T105 to T109ExperimentManifest, delayed-fill schedule restructure, T109_HISTORICAL_UNAVAILABLE verdict, atomic failed/cancelled/incomplete gate. All deliverables are in src/ and tests/; no docs/spec/ file is named in Deliverables or Acceptance.

todo/reviews/P06/T109/review-002.md required_changes list names exactly the gaps the Developer's attempt-003-developer.json claims to have closed: BacktestEvent block_number/transaction_index/log_index, orchestrator (timestamp, 0, 0) fallback removal, T061 engine delayed-fill pipeline restructure, explicit pre-evidence historical unavailable verdict, additional integration tests (TestDelayedFillCausalSchedule, TestStrategyReplacementAfterRealRun, TestEndToEndT061RunStateEquivalence, TestPreEvidenceHistoricalUnavailable, TestPredecessorSuccessPathUnreachableForT105).

todo/evidence/P06/T109/attempt-003-developer.json `commands` records `git restore --staged --worktree docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md todo/config.yaml` (protected-path edits reverted) and `git diff --stat` (10 source/test files modified). No candidate commit was created; `git status` is clean and HEAD == 1d9634f in the worktree.

todo/evidence/P06/T109/attempt-002-developer.json and review-002.md confirm the prior attempt-2 state (commit fac669a) is the worktree's code-only baseline; attempt 3's code changes were never committed and were wiped by the controller's restore.

docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:154 lists the §2.2 T069 row referencing `robinhood_lp.application.backtest_runs`, which does not resolve under src/robinhood_lp/. This citation drift reproduces on base 0ef2ce0 per both review-002.md and attempt-002-developer.json; it is a pre-existing docs defect, not introduced by T109 and not in T109's deliverable list.

The contract's 'Must not' clause forbids leaving a predecessor-format current success path reachable, applying a delayed fill before its actual cursor, post-sorting a non-causal audit history, inferring an exact cursor from integer time, and embedding the complete market timeline. All of these are addressed by code-only changes in src/ and tests/, none requires a docs/spec/ edit.

T069 and T105 are recorded in todo/config.yaml as `superseded_by: T109`, so the contract already specifies replacement; no contract amendment is needed to assert T109's authority over the predecessor surface.

Review 2's `lint-typing-format: UNKNOWN` verdict notes two pre-existing repository-wide failures (test_abi_artifacts forge submodule missing; test_documentation_citations T069 reference drift) reproduce on the base commit and are unrelated to T109.
recommended_action: Open a new T109 Developer attempt with an explicit code-only scope guard: edits confined to src/ and tests/. The Developer must (1) re-apply the Review 2 required_changes that were implemented in attempt 3 but reverted (BacktestEvent cursor fields; removal of the (timestamp, 0, 0) fallback in src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py; T061 engine pending-pipeline restructure via _enqueue_pipeline / _release_due_pipelines in src/robinhood_lp/backtest/engine.py; explicit ReplayHistoricalUnavailableError + HISTORICAL_UNAVAILABLE_REASON in src/robinhood_lp/reports/run_state.py; the new acceptance test classes in tests/test_t109_acceptance.py and updated fixtures in tests/test_backtest_t061.py / tests/test_backtest_t069.py); (2) re-execute the full pytest suite end-to-end on the unmodified worktree — no docs/spec/ or todo/config.yaml edits; (3) run ruff check, ruff format --check, and strict mypy on the candidate files; (4) commit the candidate.
